Kanji Boy 3.name: Kanji Boy 3
Kanji Boy 3.summary: The third installment of "Kanji BOY" that makes you smarter while playing games. The number of questions recorded is over 7,000! As you play, you will naturally acquire kanji. There are two game modes. There is a "existing question collection mode" where you can play the exams from the 2nd to 10th grades that have been asked in the past, and a "mini game mode" where you can get idioms about your body, health, animals, and living.

Lemmings & Oh No! More Lemmings.name: Lemmings & Oh No! More Lemmings
Lemmings & Oh No! More Lemmings.summary: This port for the Game Boy Color sees almost everything downgraded due to the reduced hardware capabilities. The resolution is now 8 bit, the screen size is heavily reduced resulting in a lot of zoom over the original, and the soundtrack is rescored to fit the limited 8-bit sound card
